title: UL-01 — Challenge: Identity, budget, and preflight
scenario: Design daily vs break-glass IAM roles with boundaries. Do not repeat GL-01 step list.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate IAM role workbook-ul01-daily exists with permissions boundary referencing GL-01 deny pattern.
Break-glass role workbook-ul01-breakglass exists with tighter trust requiring MFA.
Daily role inline policy denies iam:CreateUser and budgets:ModifyBudget.
Break-glass trust policy requires aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent for AssumeRole.
No access keys created for either role.
Both roles tagged LabId=ul-01 with Workbook=aws-tf-lab.
Trust policies document who may assume each role.
You assume the daily role via STS. If you already completed GL-03, list that bucket read-only; otherwise prove the role cannot call iam:CreateUser.
Break-glass assume is documented but not used for routine lab steps.
Teardown deletes inline policies before roles.
No new IAM users or MFA devices are created in UL-01.
GL-01 budget and lab user are not modified or deleted by UL-01 teardown.
Tag search LabId=ul-01 is empty after cleanup.
Kill-switch snippet applies only to tagged LabId resources.
You record which role you used for each STS call in your notes.

hints.text: Use permission boundaries on both roles.

solution.outline: Daily vs break-glass IAM design with teardown.

stopChargesPanel: Delete ul-01 roles and policies; keep GL-01 user unless you created ul-01-only principals.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: none (the roles are named workbook-ul01-daily and workbook-ul01-breakglass)
# Lost track? List what is left: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-01

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul01-daily --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul01-daily --policy-name $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul01-breakglass --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul01-breakglass --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-ul01-daily returns NoSuchEntity
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-01 returns empty
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. List LabId=ul-01 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-01. Delete only those ids after typing your account id from aws sts get-caller-identity. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Finish GL-01 first. GL-03 is optional for the bucket check.
